projectConfig.title: Design handoff
projectConfig.why: /design-implement re-expresses an exported design in this project's own stack and then measures the result against it. Where the tokens live, where components live, how the app is served for a screenshot, and which checks must pass are all project facts the design export cannot contain.

schema.description: Design-handoff contract consumed by design-pack. Required for /design-implement. This fragment is mirrored in plugins/design-pack/requirements.json, which the dashboard renders the config form from; scripts/check-plugin-requirements.sh fails CI when the two drift, so change both in one commit.

tokensFile.description: Repo-relative CSS file that holds the design tokens an implementation must extend rather than duplicate, e.g. src/app/globals.css

componentsRoot.description: Repo-relative directory the reuse-vs-create survey walks before anything new is built, e.g. src/components

routesRoot.description: Repo-relative directory holding routable pages, e.g. src/app

fontLoader.description: How this project loads typefaces. A design font missing from the project stops the run with instructions written for this loader; it is never silently substituted.

devCommand.description: Command that serves the app so an implemented route can be screenshotted, e.g. npm run dev

devUrl.description: Base URL devCommand serves on, e.g. http://localhost:3000. Never a shared or production origin.

verify.description: Check commands run after implementation. Both are mandatory.

lint.description: Lint command, e.g. npm run lint

diff.description: Pixel-diff acceptance for the verification phase.

threshold.description: Maximum percentage of differing pixels that still counts as a match

pixelTolerance.description: Per-pixel colour tolerance passed to the diff, 0 = exact

budget.description: Autonomy limits before the implementation agent stops and returns the decision to the operator.

maxIterations.description: Diff-then-fix rounds the agent may run unattended

maxFiles.description: Files the agent may touch before it must stop

probe.prompt:
You are filling in one project's design-handoff configuration for a Claude Code plugin. This is a READ-ONLY inspection of the repository: do not create, edit, move, or delete any file, and do not run installs, builds, or dev servers.

Inspect the project working directory and suggest values for the requested fields:

1. tokensFile — the CSS file that defines the project's design tokens. Look for a stylesheet containing an @theme block (Tailwind v4), a :root block with custom properties, or a @tailwind/@import "tailwindcss" directive. Prefer the one imported by the root layout. Report it repo-relative.
2. componentsRoot — the directory holding reusable UI components. If a shadcn/ui components.json exists, read its aliases.components value and resolve it through tsconfig/jsconfig paths to a real directory. Otherwise pick the directory with the highest count of component-shaped files.
3. routesRoot — the directory holding routable pages: an app/ directory containing page files, a pages/ directory, or the framework's equivalent.
4. devCommand — the package.json script that serves the app locally, expressed as the full command a shell would run (npm run <script>, pnpm <script>, yarn <script>) according to the lockfile present.
5. devUrl — the base URL that command serves on. Take it from an explicit --port/-p flag, a PORT entry in a committed env file, or the framework's documented default. Never suggest a deployed, staging, or production origin.
6. verify.lint and verify.typecheck — the package.json scripts that lint and type-check, expressed the same way. If no type-check script exists but TypeScript is a dependency, suggest the direct type-check invocation used by that toolchain.

Rules: suggest only values you actually found evidence for; omit a field entirely rather than guessing. Every path must exist. Return at most a few candidates per field, most likely first.

Output rules — these are absolute:
- Emit ONE JSON object and nothing else. No prose before or after it, no code fence, no explanation.
- Shape: {"suggestions":{"tokensFile":["…"],"componentsRoot":["…"],"routesRoot":["…"],"devCommand":["…"],"devUrl":["…"],"verify.lint":["…"],"verify.typecheck":["…"]},"notes":"…"}
- Every value must be something you actually read from a file. If a field has no evidence, OMIT that key entirely rather than filling it with a guess.
- Keep `notes` to one short sentence, and only when something is worth flagging.
